cross_references.source_quote: Cement shall be ordinary Portland cement conforming to IS 269 for all purpose unless specified differently.
Water shall be tested in accordance with IS 3025.
Grading of coarse aggregate shall conform to the requirements in IS 383.
Grading of fine aggregate shall conform to IS 383 and shall fall within limits of one of the four zones given in table 4 of IS 383.
The maximum quantities of deleterious materials in the coarse aggregate ... shall not exceed the limits provided in Table -- 8.
The design shall be carried out strictly to IS specifications and IS code practice 456
minimum cement content per cubic meter of reinforced concrete should not be less than that stipulated in table 23, 24, 25 and 26 of SP 23
The design shall be carried out strictly to IS specifications and IS code practice 456, SP 23 and SP 24
when tested according to Is 1199 and IS 2386 - Part III
when tested according to Is 1199 and IS 2386 - Part III
Cubes shall be cast, stored, cured, transported and tested per IS 516

source_quotes.exposure: Moderate - for example, sheltered from heavy and wind driven rain and against freezing, whilst saturated with water; buried concrete in soil and concrete continuously under water.
